sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 381 of 2023
Petitioner :- Faiz Khan And Another
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Aftab Ahamad,Anubhav Pandey

Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Mohammad Mustafa Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Saurabh Srivastava,J.

Heard Sri Aftab Ahamad, learned counsel for the petitioners, Mohammad Mustafa, learned counsel appearing for the informant and learned A.G.A for the State respondents.
The relief sought in this petition is for quashing of the F.I.R. dated 6.12.2022 registered as Case Crime No. 278 of 2022, under Sections 376, 354-Ga, 323, 504, 506, 406 IPC, Police Station Khuldabad, District Prayagraj.
Further prayer has been made not to arrest the petitioner in the aforesaid case.
Learned AGA opposed the prayer for quashing of the FIR, which discloses cognizable offence.
He further submits that the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. is also against the petitioners.

sentences.text: Perusal of the impugned first information report prima facie reveals commission of cognizable offence.

Therefore, in view of the law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of State of Haryana and others vs. Bhajan Lal and others, 1992 Supp. (1) SCC 335 and M/s Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra, AIR 2021 SC 1918 and in Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No.3262/2021 (Leelavati Devi @ Leelawati & another vs. the State of Uttar Pradesh) decided on 07.10.2021, no case has been made out for interference with the impugned first information report.
